name: Agent Barn
tagline: Run your AI agents from one place
description: Agent Barn is an open-source control plane to create, configure, run, and monitor AI agents across Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram from one place. Open-source core with versioned agent configuration, guardrails, run history and human approval steps, plus secure tool and secret integration. Open source and free to self-host; managed cloud from $20/month.
